## Recommended description (255 char limit)

> Typed React UI library — ThemeProvider with CSS-variable theming, dark mode, design tokens, forms (react-hook-form / TanStack Form), data tables, overlays, date pickers, Tailwind v4 preset. RSC-ready, a11y-tested. MIT.

## CLI helper

```bash
gh repo edit MrKamura/kovax \
  --description "Typed React UI library — ThemeProvider with CSS-variable theming, dark mode, design tokens, forms (react-hook-form / TanStack Form), data tables, overlays, date pickers, Tailwind v4 preset. RSC-ready, a11y-tested. MIT." \
  --homepage "https://mrkamura.github.io/kovax/" \
  --add-topic react,react-components,react-library,react-ui,react-ui-library,react-component-library,ui-kit,ui-library,ui-components,component-library,design-system,design-tokens,typescript,headless-ui,dark-mode,theming,css-variables,accessibility,a11y,wai-aria,nextjs,app-router,rsc,react-server-components,tailwindcss,tailwind-v4,react-hook-form,tanstack-form,storybook,forms,datatable,pagination,date-picker,overlays,modal,popover,combobox,responsive,breakpoints,hooks,frontend,opensource
```

GitHub limits a repo to **20 topics** — pick the most searched first (react-components, react-ui-library, component-library, design-system, ui-kit, dark-mode, accessibility, nextjs, tailwindcss, react-hook-form, storybook, …).
